test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A candidate scores 25% marks and fails by 68 marks, while another candidate, who scores 50% marks, gets 42 marks more than the minimum required marks to pass the examination. Find the maximum marks for the examination.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in percentage = 50% − 25% = 25%

Difference in marks = 68 (failed by) + 42 (passed by) = 110 marks

25% of total marks = 110 marks

Total maximum marks = 110 × 4 = 440 marks

**∴ The correct answer is 440 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks scored by Candidate 1 = 25%

Marks failed by Candidate 1 = 68 marks

Marks scored by Candidate 2 = 50%

Marks passed by Candidate 2 = 42 marks
